title: Graduate Trainee Accountant - Ennis - 2027
description:
Vacancy Name

Graduate Trainee Accountant - Ennis - 2027

Company Description

Xeinadin Group was established in 2019 when more than 100 successful, independent, business advisory and accountancy practices across the UK and Ireland came together to re-imagine the future of accountancy. Our collective mission to provide locally forged, trusted business advice to SMEs through forward-thinking, close-knit relationships remains pivotal to our growth. It is our people who help drive our business forward, and we offer them future-focused career opportunities whilst supporting the individual specialisms. Our regional offices of over 1800 colleagues operate in collaboration across the Group, combining collective expertise to maximise our people’s potential. As part of one Xeinadin, our colleagues are able to draw on expertise and support from across our UK, Ireland and central teams, as well as benefitting from being a part of their local communities.

Description

At Xeinadin, we believe the best way to learn is by doing.

Our Trainee opportunities gives ambitious graduates the chance to build a rewarding career while working towards a professional qualification in Accounting, Audit and Tax. From your first day, you'll become part of a supportive team where you'll gain meaningful, hands-on experience, work with real clients and develop the skills needed for a successful career in professional services.

Unlike larger firms where graduates can become specialists early in their careers, our local offices offer exposure to a wide variety of work. You'll build relationships with clients, work alongside experienced colleagues and gain practical experience across multiple industries while supporting the small and medium-sized businesses that are the backbone of the Irish economy.

Apply here for our Ennis office location.

Applications close Friday 16th of October 2026.

Key Responsibilities

Support the team in delivering a range of accounting, audit and tax services to clients.

Assist with the preparation of financial statements, management accounts and other financial reports.

Support audit engagements, including gathering information, performing basic testing and preparing audit documentation.

Assist with the preparation of tax returns and calculations, and support the team with Revenue-related matters.

Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records and financial information.

Liaise with clients and colleagues to obtain information and resolve queries in a professional manner.

Complete routine accounting and administrative tasks accurately and within agreed deadlines.

Develop an understanding of clients’ businesses and the financial and regulatory requirements relevant to them.

Work collaboratively with colleagues across different service areas while also taking responsibility for individual tasks.

Continually develop technical knowledge and professional skills through on-the-job experience and professional examinations.

Contribute to delivering high-quality work while adhering to Xeinadin’s processes, standards and values.

Key Requirements

We are looking for someone who is:

Completing a business or finance related third-level qualification. (Currently in your final year)

On track for a 2.1 degree or higher

Is motivated to pursue a professional Accounting or Tax qualification.

Is curious, eager to learn and ready to take on new challenges.

Enjoys building relationships and working collaboratively.

Has strong communication and problem-solving skills.

Is enthusiastic about helping businesses and making a positive impact for clients.

Additional Requirements

We are looking for someone who has:

Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to meet deadlines.

A proactive approach to learning, with a willingness to ask questions and take on feedback.

Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills.

Professional and confident communication skills, with the ability to build positive relationships with colleagues and clients.

Ability to adapt to changing priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Commitment to ongoing professional development and studying towards a professional accounting qualification.

Genuine interest in accountancy, business and developing a long-term career in professional services.

title: 2027 Graduate Programme - Fund Accounting
description:
ABOUT US:

As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 7,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.

With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.

Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com

ABOUT THE PROGRAMME

The aim of Alter Domus’ Graduate Programme is to create a graduate experience that develops individuals’ professional and technical skills, fosters engagement and understanding with the wider business and provides an opportunity for accelerated career growth with Alter Domus.

Our Graduate Programme commences in September each year - unless you would like to start earlier. A key part of our Graduate Programme is the facilitation of 12 month rotations across the key areas of our business, namely Private Debt, Private Equity, Real Estate and Fund of Funds.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

Taking care of the day-to-day operations of the funds and following up with third parties, including investors and fund managers. Undergoing aninteractive onboarding & training program designed to quickly and effectively give new joiners the industry skills and contexts needed. You will take part in the setup of funds, and implementing complex international real estate structures as part of restructuring plans, mergers and acquisitions. Preparing the funds’ periodic Net Asset Value calculation and year-end financial statements, management of the audit, and reviewing other fund related reports. Reviewing tax returns and tax balances and maintaining relevant contacts with the tax authorities. Taking an active part in the initial setup of any new funds take-on and liaising with independent tax specialists, lawyers, and notaries as part of the set up process.

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN:

Expertise per sub-asset class: All teams specialise in a given asset class (Private Equity, Real Estate, Debt, Fund Of Funds) End-to-end processing by an integrated team of generalists with full knowledge and control over the full process rather than functionalization of the teams. Expert Pools support the delivery teams on specific topics: Consolidation, Liquidations, Tax Compliance, Transfer Pricing, Investor Customer Due Diligence (CDD).

YOUR PROFILE:

You should be working towards a 2.1 degree (or above) in areas such as Finance, Accounting, Business or Economics You are interested in accounting for investment products, particularly funds in the Real Estate, Private Equity or Private Debt industries, a relevant internship an advantage You are interested in pursuing further professional development through the ACCA pathway You enjoy communicating and collaborating within a team to help solved problems and generate results andyou are reliableand organized. WHAT WE OFFER

We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.

Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.

Grad benefits also include:

Support forACCA accreditation including study leave Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday and graduation! Continuous mentoring along your career progression Active sports, events and social committees across our offices 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan Health Insurance Pension Scheme

Equity in every sense of the word:

We are in the business of equity, in every sense of the word. For us, this means taking action to ensure every colleague has equal opportunity, valuing every voice and experience across our organisation, maintaining an inclusive culture where you can bring your whole self to work, and making Alter Domus a workplace where everyone feels they belong.

We celebrate our differences, and understand that our success relies on diverse perspectives and experiences, working towards shared goals and a common purpose. We take pride in creating a workplace where all our people are empowered to be truly invested in the alternative and bring their whole selves to work.

We are committed to ensuring a welcoming recruiting and onboarding process for everyone. Please contact our hiring team if you require any accommodations to make our recruitment process more accessible for you.

(Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy-notice/)

For further information, and to apply, please visit our website via the “Apply” button below.

title: Trainee Accountant Graduate x2
description:
Trainee Accountant Graduate x2
Newbridge
The Role:

BnM is seeking a Trainee Accountant Graduate to join our team in Newbridge on a Fixed Term Contract. The Graduate Trainee Accountant position will be supported by BnM to complete the Chartered Accountant (ACA) qualification over a period of 3 - 4 years (depending on exemptions). The position will provide work experience rotations across various finance teams within BnM while also supporting the Graduate Trainee Accountant by providing paid exam fees and study leave.

The main duties and responsibilities of the role will include the following:

Support the line manager and other members of the Finance team in the delivery of assigned tasks and projects, including the delivery of month end and year end. Use these opportunities to apply the theory from ACA studies into practice to ensure all prescribed competencies are achieved per the development framework.
Proactively participate in the ACA training programme and in the Graduate Development workshops. Ensure CA diary, which documents required ACA trainee accountant work experience, is completed and reviewed regularly.
Assist other finance team members with tasks and required and proactively seek opportunities to improve and expand knowledge and skills. Aim to take ownership of more complicated tasks as part of your progression through the trainee accountant programme.
Engage regularly with assigned mentor to improve knowledge of the organisation and identify key areas for development. Proactively build a network of contacts throughout the organisation through work experience with different finance teams.
All employees are expected to co-operate fully with all provisions taken by the company for ensuring Health and Safety, and Welfare of co-employees and members of the public using the premises.
Proactively participate in the Performance Management process to ensure delivery of own, and the wider team's objectives.
What we're looking for:
The ideal candidate will possess the following qualification, skills, knowledge, and attributes:

Level 8 degree in Accountancy, Business, or a related discipline.
Competent in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Ability to work effectively and efficiently, both independently and as part of a team.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
Apply Now

If you're ready to join a team that’s creating real impact, apply on or before 30 Oct 2026.

BnM is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Audit Graduate
description:
Audit Graduate

Application Deadline: 31 October 2026

Department: Audit

Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Galway, Ireland

DescriptionOur graduate programme fast tracks you to success, moving you from graduate to qualified accountant with either Chartered Accountants Ireland (ACA) or the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA). Moore has platinum status with ACCA, allowing ACCA trainees to avail of the exemption to prepare a training diary during the course of their traineeship with us.

Our programme is aimed at third level (level 8) graduates coming from accounting/business & finance academic backgrounds. You do not need to have had prior practical experience in an accounting firm in order to apply.

We offer a comprehensive traineeship to cover all aspects of your development. Alongside the varied work experience you will receive, we also provide our trainees with the best in house training.

Everything we do during our graduate programme is focused on providing you with the best possible training in the broadest range of accounting disciplines. Your traineeship will include mentoring and development of skills in the areas of:
Audit casesAudit exempt casesFinancial statement preparationCorporation taxManagement accountsVAT/PAYE & other tax areasWe have a wide range of clients across many sectors including manufacturing, shipping, property management, financial services, aviation, construction, leisure and hospitality, and technology. Our client base varies in size from large international groups to small/medium owner managed entities. We can offer a very broad experience to our candidates in multiple disciplines and across many industries. We do this because we know that you are our future and we want your experience to be as well-rounded as possible.

Diversity in Experience

We are passionate about diversity and inclusion and we seek to attract talented individuals from a wide and diverse talent pool. Our business is made stronger by the different perspectives and experiences of our people and we feel it is important and in line with our values that we continue to build a workforce which is representative of our society as it is today.

Retain Your Academic Focus

Almost all of our work culminates in analysing something complex, breaking it down into something simple, understanding it, explaining it, and writing a meaningful and constructive report. We want people to help us do this, and to do it well. We are keen to meet and invest in bright, energetic, analytical, mathematical, open-minded and diligent students. Recent Global events has shone a bright light on the brittleness of our understanding of the contours of risk. In this regard, looking beyond 2024, we have made and continue to make assessments on upstream areas for our clients such as climate change, diversity and inclusion, operational resilience, cyber, liquidity and staff well-being.
Rewards and BenefitsWe offer a highly competitive reward structure including excellent salaries and an attractive package of core benefits, which we review regularly to ensure we remain competitive. Our benefits include:

Competitive market based salary22 days annual leaveExam fees coveredTuition fees coveredPaid study leave in line with recommended leave allowance by CAI/ACCACycle to work scheme
